annotation.title_en: Civil Aeronautics Act (Aviation Act) of Japan
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Japan (National Diet; Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism)
annotation.summary_en: Japan's Civil Aeronautics Act (1952, as amended to take effect 1 December 2025) governs aircraft registration, airworthiness, aviation personnel, airports, operations and air transport. Chapter 11 regulates unmanned aircraft (drones): registration, airframe certification, pilot competency certificates, registered inspection and training bodies, and flight rules. It also covers decarbonisation of aviation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Aircraft must be registered and hold valid airworthiness certificates to be operated.
Type certification and designation of approved workshops for design, manufacture and maintenance.
Chapter 11 sets registration of unmanned aircraft, airframe certification, and remote pilot skill certificates (3-year validity).
Registered training, inspection and testing bodies are supervised by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism.
Chapter 10 promotes decarbonisation of aviation; penalties set in Chapter 13.
